question.text: F&O / derivative business losses incurred in a PMS account can be carried forward for:

explanation.text: The Logic: Derivative (F&O) business losses can be carried forward for up to 8 assessment years and set off only against business income in those subsequent years. The Trap: The other durations do not match the statutory carry-forward period for derivative business losses. Note: The carry-forward applies to derivative/F&O business losses; carried-forward loss can be adjusted only against business income, not against other heads.
